decisions_made: Tích hợp Unified Reverse Engineering Graph Query CLI trong scripts/agent/query_dupery_graph.py với 5 subcommands (inspect-class, inspect-scene, inspect-asset, get-recipe, coverage-stats) và cờ --generate-report.
